narrative.title: The Orchard Harvest Cart
narrative.scenario: A farm worker walks a single row of trees, each tree bearing exactly one fruit of a given type, and may carry only two crates — one per fruit type, but each with unlimited capacity. Starting anywhere and moving strictly rightward, they must pick from every tree they pass and stop the moment a third fruit type appears. The forecaster wants the largest haul achievable.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer array fruits where fruits[i] is the fruit type of tree i.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the maximum number of fruits collectible from one contiguous run of trees using at most two types.

testCases.explanation: Two types across three trees fit the two crates exactly.
Starting at tree 1 lets the picker ride types 2 and 3 through four trees.

hintLevels: Level 1: Two baskets means the answer window may hold at most two distinct values.
Level 2: Track type frequencies in the window; a third type forces evictions from the left.
Level 3: Evict whole types, not counts — a type only leaves the window when its frequency hits zero.
